note: Encode timings and settings of this repository's own Kaggle runs, one entry per model. s_per_page is the page-encoding time per page (page_seconds / pages, from the encode log); step_s_per_page is the whole encode step per page (step_seconds / pages, from run.json: model download and load, the 12-pair check, page and query encoding); setup_s is the step minus page and query encoding. A text model's unit is a document. gpus is how many GPUs the model spanned. Times on other hardware differ; easy mode prints them as estimates with this basis.
